question: What term describes the Church's official teaching authority, exercised by the pope and bishops?

teaching.title: The Magisterium
teaching.body: The Magisterium is the living teaching office of the Church, entrusted to the pope and bishops in communion with him. It operates in two modes: solemn (ex cathedra definitions, ecumenical councils) and ordinary (consistent, universal teaching). Its authority rests on Christ's promise to guide the Church into all truth (John 16:13) and to be with his apostles always (Matt 28:20).
